name: Stage deploy and consumer verification
description: Verify origin/main carries an unreleased version, get npm web auth in place (forwarding the login URL, cancelling after 60 minutes), dispatch the GitHub Actions stage job, wait for the stage to be ready, run the README consumer verification against the ST-Test project, then report the results and offer to promote the stage to a live npm release and tag it.
examples: run the stage deploy and test it against st-test
stage 4.6.0 and verify it in the consumer project

inputs.name: st_test_path
inputs.description: Directory of the ST-Test consumer project

inputs.name: auth_timeout_minutes
inputs.description: Minutes to wait for the npm web login before cancelling the run

inputs.name: stage_timeout_minutes
inputs.description: Minutes to wait for the staged version to become inspectable on the registry

args.invoke: record the ST-Test result above as a stage_tested ledger entry for stage ${steps.stage_ready.outputs.stage_id} (pass or fail per the report), without re-running stage test
